correctness.rationale: In F_q[eps]/eps^2, (A+eps B)^m=A^m+eps*sum_{i=0}^{m-1} A^i B A^{m-1-i}. If A^r=0 and A^{r-1} nonzero, the 2r power vanishes while the (2r-1) power is eps A^{r-1} B A^{r-1}. For P=A^{r-1}, B->PBP has rank rank(P^T tensor P)=s^2, giving q^(n^2)-q^(n^2-s^2) lifts with maximal index and probability 1-q^(-s^2). Nilpotent Jordan theory identifies s with the number of blocks of size r; includes A=0, r=1. Independently exhausted six small binary Jordan-type strata and agrees.
